search_arxiv_query: search arXiv for papers matching a text query and display formatted results
search_arxiv_author: search arXiv for papers by a specific author and display formatted results
search_arxiv_category: search arXiv for papers in a specific category and display formatted results
search_arxiv_id: search arXiv for papers by their arXiv ID and display formatted results
search_arxiv_sort: search arXiv for papers sorted by date, relevance, or last updated date
